title: Breakup Glow-Up Budget Map
oneLiner: A post-breakup self-reinvention planner that helps users split beauty, fitness, wardrobe, and photo investments into a realistic confidence comeback plan without revenge-spending chaos.
targetUser: Recently single adults who want to look and feel visibly better within 30 to 90 days without blowing savings on impulsive makeover spending.
keyUX: Set a comeback deadline, rank appearance upgrades by visible payoff, and convert emotional spending impulses into a calmer staged plan.
stitchPrompt: Design a desktop self-reinvention planner called Breakup Glow-Up Budget Map for recently single adults who want a visible confidence comeback without impulsive revenge spending. It should help users rank beauty, fitness, wardrobe, and photo-related upgrades by visible payoff, emotional value, and budget safety over the next 30 to 90 days. Include a comeback confidence snapshot, a visible payoff priority board, a beauty and wardrobe spend planner, a fitness and habit streak panel, a social-photo readiness timeline, and a revenge-spend guardrail drawer. Design direction: use a premium-editorial aesthetic with warm stone surfaces, flattering lighting cues, elegant typography, and polished luxury spacing so the product feels aspirational, emotionally charged, and controlled rather than chaotic.
